items.item: The matrix is a real table with row and column headers; every checkbox has an accessible name combining module and action
items.evidence: Real <table> with <thead><th> action headers and <th scope="row"> module names; cell checkboxes use aria-label="${m.name} - ${a.name}" (e.g. 'Đơn hàng - Duyệt'); row/column aggregates have 'Chọn cả hàng X' / 'Chọn cột X'. Column th lack scope attribute but sit in thead.

items.item: Rows or columns can be toggled in bulk, with an indeterminate state when partially selected
items.evidence: Row checkboxes [data-row] and column checkboxes [data-col] in thead; syncAggregates() sets c.indeterminate = n>0 && n<total. Screenshot shows indeterminate dashes in 'Tất cả' column and 'Duyệt' header.

items.item: Changes use an explicit save with a visible unsaved-changes indicator and a warning when leaving
items.evidence: Explicit 'Lưu thay đổi' / 'Hoàn tác' buttons and #dirty badge 'Có thay đổi chưa lưu' plus '*' in role list exist, but there is no beforeunload handler and switching roles gives no leave warning (roleList click just changes current).

items.item: System or locked roles are read-only and say why
items.evidence: r.system makes all checkboxes disabled; #lockNote shows 'Vai trò hệ thống có toàn quyền và không thể chỉnh sửa.' and a 'Hệ thống' badge in the list. Reason is only generic but present.

items.item: Deleting a role asks for confirmation naming the role and how many users it affects
items.evidence: No delete control or delete handler exists anywhere in the page.

items.item: The screen shows who last changed the role and when, or links to its audit history
items.evidence: #roleMeta shows only user count and permission count; no last-modified by/when and no audit link (the 'Nhật ký hoạt động' nav item is generic, not role-specific).

items.item: All controls are keyboard operable and pointer targets are at least 24px
items.evidence: Native <button>, <input type=checkbox>, <input type=search> throughout, with focus rings on buttons/search; audit metrics smallTargets: 0 of 67 checked (16px checkboxes pass via spacing). Minor: row cells hover only, no focus ring on checkboxes beyond browser default.

notes: Solid permission matrix core (indeterminate bulk toggles, view-dependency rule, dirty state, locked system role). Missing: leave warning, role delete with confirmation, last-changed/audit info; 'Thêm vai trò' uses window.prompt. Audit score 90 with two text-contrast errors (#roleMeta text-slate-400 at 2.56:1, role list meta 4.26:1). Tailwind via CDN.
